python.policy: code and dependency lock must pass both supported interpreter lines

http_host.uvicorn_install: minimal package only; do not use uvicorn[standard]
http_host.rationale: small ASGI surface, current Python support, few hard dependencies, explicit programmatic lifecycle

persistence.query_style: parameterized SQL through SOMA-owned repository/query adapters
persistence.connection_thread_rule: check_same_thread=true; a connection never crosses threads
persistence.write_transaction: explicit BEGIN IMMEDIATE / COMMIT / ROLLBACK under SOMA UnitOfWork
persistence.read_transaction: short read connection; no application-global shared connection

sqlite_runtime.foreign_keys: ON and verified per authoritative connection
sqlite_runtime.configuration_rule: failure to apply/verify required safety pragmas blocks authoritative use

migration.framework: SOMA-owned raw SQL runner; no Alembic/ORM migration layer
migration.execution: statement-by-statement inside explicit transaction; sqlite3.executescript is forbidden

json.canonicalization: only for contracts that require equality/fingerprint/checksum

identifiers.domain_ids: deferred to owning domain LLD where already routed

time.rule: wall-clock local time is never persistence authority

concurrency.asgi_event_loop: transport and orchestration only; no blocking SQLite/file parsing
concurrency.rule: blocking application/repository work runs in bounded host-owned executors and obtains its own connection

requirements: selected live-data protection must cover protected data in database/journal sidecars or require an accepted journal-mode change
run-auth and anti-forgery wrap runtime control endpoints
diagnostic sanitization wraps host/server exception reporting
